This documents outlines the major maintenance procedure P2, which must be 
 performed every five years as indicated by Y5 in the title block.

This pump is used to push the cooling 
 water through heat exchangers to cool the auxiliaries equipment.

Abd El Gilil EDEPC MPIS coordinator, and certified by accountant; Mahmoud 
Mohamed Soliman; EDEPC admin and financial inspection, quality control General 
Director and supervisor of inspection and quality control head sector.

Disconnect coupling.

 as follow:

Jack and remove dowel Pins from upper 
 half casing.

Loosen upper half-casing (100).

 the upper half casing

 unit.
Caps must be replaced on the same end of Pump from which they were removed.
They should be marked for identification before disassembly.

Carefully lift rotating assembly from 
 unit and Place on padded supports, which not injure the shaft sleeves.
 Note: the distance from the end of the shaft to the face of the Pump 
 half coupling so that the coupling half can be correctly positioned when 
 reassembled.

 shaft.
Dismantle coupling key.

Drain the oil from the bearing housing 
 (134).

 (109) and remove end cover (109) from bearing housing.
Preserve end cover gaskets (360).

Dismantle snap ring (361) from shaft 
 (122).

 and 137) from shaft seat.

Slide ball bearing collar (237) of the 
 shaft (122).

Slide ball bearing housings (134) from 
 shaft (122).

Dismantle deflectors (123) 
 from shaft (122) and Slip casing wearing rings (103) from impeller (101) and 
 off rotating element.

Slide packing (106), lantern rings (105) 
 and stuffing box bushings (125) off ends of shaft (122)

Smooth the exposed portions of the shaft 
 at the end of the sleeves with fine emery cloth so that sleeve will not bind 
 while being removed

Mark the location of the keyway on the 
 out side of both the impeller hub and the locking sleeve (104) at Point (A) 
 and (B)

Measure clearance of all diametral 
 running of the pump

 shaft (122) with a pin Spencer.

Tap the Impeller (101) from shaft with 
 lead mall.
Dismantle Key (178) from Key way.

Unscrew and remove shaft sleeve (104) by 
 hand or with a strop wrench.

Take care shaft to sleeve threads is right 
 hand

Inspect the validity 
 of thrust and ball bearing (112 -137) for wear and corrosion

Check all parts for 
 any worn out and renewed if it is need.

 delivery Pipes for creep.

 of shaft (permissible limit)

 wearing rings dimension clearance and renewed if it is need

Check the impeller for 
 correct setting and renewed it if need

 A).

Change (360) and oil 
 seal (332, 333).

Clean all contact surfaces before 
 mounting.

Determine the correct setting of the 
 impeller (distance B) and the sleeves on the shaft in relation to the rotation 
 of the Pump.

Assemble the shaft sleeve (104) that has 
 a keyway in the thread end.

Place O - Ring ( 412A ) in the groove in 
 end of shaft sleeve (104) Assemble first the shaft sleeve )

Slide Impeller on shaft and tap in place 
 against the sleeve with a Lead mall.

Place O - Ring ( 412 ) in the groove in 
 end of shaft sleeve ( 126 )
Screw shaft sleeve on shaft up to key.
Slip wearing rings on impeller.

Place stuffing box bushing (125) on 
 shaft.
Place deflectors (123) on shaft.

Wipe a small amount of grease of on the 
 oil seal lips in a bearing housing.

Place bearing housing on shaft and slide 
 them along unit they contact the shaft sleeves.

Slide ball bearing collar (237) over 
 thrust end of shaft (122) and push up against shaft shoulder.

Install the thrust and coupling end ball 
 bearing on either end of shaft.

Place snap ring (361) in grove in shaft 
 on thrust bearing end.

Oil shaft extension and slide coupling 
 and bearing and cover (119) with gasket (360) in place.
Assemble the pump half coupling.

Bolt the thrust end Bearing end cover to 
 the bearing housing.

Smooth up and clean casing wearing ring, 
 stuffing box bushing and bearing housing seats in upper and Lower half casing.

Check and measure clearance of all 
 diametral running of the pump.

Check the rotating elements for free 
 turning.

Assemble bearing caps (111) and tighten 
 the nuts evenly.

Check again for free turning of the 
 rotating.

Repack stuffing boxes and replace gland 
 assemblies.
Check coupling alignment.
Connect coupling.
Oil pump bearings.

Connect 
 auxiliary piping such as oil pipe (190) constant level oilier (251) and 
 water seal pipe (102)
Check the direction of rotation of pump.
Opens the cooling water to each gland and the quantity of water is sufficient.
Checks the level of oil in constant level oilier for thrust bearing.

Priming of the pump by open suction valve, close discharge valve and open vent 
 valve until all airs expelled and water 
 Flows through opening.

Open the delivery valve gradually after the 
 pump has been started to operate at its full speed.

Check the discharge, pressure and vibration 
 during operation.

Check the oil level in the constant level 
 oilier.

Check the temperature of cooling water at 
 discharge.

Check the temperature of thrust bearing 
 housing and thrust bearing end cover should not exceed 60
